decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 16 November 2005, the erection of a single storey detached outbuilding measuring 13.57 metres deep (west side wall), 10.328 metres deep (east side wall), 6.14 metres wide and having a pitched roof 4 metres high was lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:
The development falls within the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class E of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because it falls within all the criteria set out in Class E.
Informative:

The detached outbuilding herby found to be lawful shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family dwellinghouse know as 55 Beavers Lane and for no other purposes (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a separate dwelling and should not include a toilet, bathroom or kitchen facilities).
description: Certificate of lawfulness for the erection of a single storey outbuilding comprising gym, playroom, garden store and storage area to rear of house.
